title: Certificate Of Insurance
description: Certificate Of Insurance contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-insurance-certificate-of-insurance
  title: Certificate Of Insurance
  description: Certificate Of Insurance contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
  version: insurance_certificate_of_insurance_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance/certificate_of_insurance
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/certificate_of_insurance
    sourceVersion: insurance_certificate_of_insurance_v1
    sourceDigest: 1a2fb211bccdaaa9ce433c761e14fe81d61571e90ef8dce58d221dbcec415ba3
spec:
  documentType: certificate_of_insurance
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - certificate-date
        - effective-dates
        - expiration-dates
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - cancellation-notice-text
        - description-of-operations
        - limits
        - waiver-of-subrogation-indicator
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - coverage-lines
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - additional-insured-indicator
        - carrier-names
        - certificate-holder-name
        - insured-name
        - producer-name
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - policy-numbers
  fields:
    - id: certificate-date
      name: certificate_date
      label: Certificate Date
      description: Date the certificate was issued.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/certificate_date
    - id: producer-name
      name: producer_name
      label: Producer Name
      description: Insurance producer or agency.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/producer_name
    - id: insured-name
      name: insured_name
      label: Insured Name
      description: Insured party named on the certificate.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/insured_name
    - id: certificate-holder-name
      name: certificate_holder_name
      label: Certificate Holder Name
      description: Certificate holder.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/certificate_holder_name
    - id: carrier-names
      name: carrier_names
      label: Carrier Names
      description: Insurers affording coverage.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/carrier_names
    - id: policy-numbers
      name: policy_numbers
      label: Policy Numbers
      description: Policy numbers shown on the certificate.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_numbers
    - id: coverage-lines
      name: coverage_lines
      label: Coverage Lines
      description: Coverage types listed.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/coverage_lines
    - id: effective-dates
      name: effective_dates
      label: Effective Dates
      description: Effective dates by coverage line.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/effective_dates
    - id: expiration-dates
      name: expiration_dates
      label: Expiration Dates
      description: Expiration dates by coverage line.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/expiration_dates
    - id: limits
      name: limits
      label: Limits
      description: Limits by coverage line or limit type.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/limits
    - id: additional-insured-indicator
      name: additional_insured_indicator
      label: Additional Insured Indicator
      description: Whether additional insured status is indicated.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/additional_insured_indicator
    - id: waiver-of-subrogation-indicator
      name: waiver_of_subrogation_indicator
      label: Waiver Of Subrogation Indicator
      description: Whether waiver of subrogation is indicated.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/waiver_of_subrogation_indicator
    - id: description-of-operations
      name: description_of_operations
      label: Description Of Operations
      description: Operations, locations, vehicles, or remarks.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/description_of_operations
    - id: cancellation-notice-text
      name: cancellation_notice_text
      label: Cancellation Notice Text
      description: Cancellation notice language.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/cancellation_notice_text
  validationRules:
    - id: insured-name-present
      severity: error
      description: insured_name is required for Certificate of Insurance extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: insured_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: insured_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: insured_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(insured_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: certificate-holder-name-present
      severity: error
      description: certificate_holder_name is required for Certificate of Insurance extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: certificate_holder_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: certificate_holder_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: certificate_holder_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(certificate_holder_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: coverage-lines-present
      severity: error
      description: coverage_lines is required for Certificate of Insurance extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: coverage_lines
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: coverage_lines
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: coverage_lines IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(coverage_lines) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      insured_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Insurance workflow.
      certificate_holder_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Insurance workflow.
      policy_numbers:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Insurance workflow.
      expiration_dates:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Insurance workflow.
      coverage_lines:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Certificate of insurance extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Certificate of Insurance documents mix policy, coverage, claim, party, financial, and regulatory
      notice context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      certificate_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the certificate was issued.
        format: date
      producer_name:
        type: string
        description: Insurance producer or agency.
      insured_name:
        type: string
        description: Insured party named on the certificate.
      certificate_holder_name:
        type: string
        description: Certificate holder.
      carrier_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Insurers affording coverage.
      policy_numbers:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Policy numbers shown on the certificate.
      coverage_lines:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Coverage types listed.
      effective_dates:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Effective dates by coverage line.
      expiration_dates:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Expiration dates by coverage line.
      limits:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            limit_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for limits item.
            limit_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for limits item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Limits by coverage line or limit type.
      additional_insured_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether additional insured status is indicated.
      waiver_of_subrogation_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether waiver of subrogation is indicated.
      description_of_operations:
        type: string
        description: Operations, locations, vehicles, or remarks.
      cancellation_notice_text:
        type: string
        description: Cancellation notice language.
    required:
      - insured_name
      - certificate_holder_name
      - coverage_lines
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: insurance_collateral_protection
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - insured_name
          - certificate_holder_name
          - coverage_lines
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - line_items
          - parties
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - limits
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
